1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 c6 3.d4 d5 4.exd5 cxd5 5.B.strategy: Trades White's light-squared bishop for Black's, ending the pressure the bishop has put on f7 since move two. The d4 pawn still attacks e5, so Black's recapture has to defend that pawn as well.

The recapture that develops a piece and defends e5 in the same move. If White takes on e5, the knight recaptures on an active square, at the price of an isolated pawn on d5 that Black must look after.
